scope: One presentation-only release notice; no fluent review claimed.

entries.source: Glossy AI maps omit duplicate driveway guides; your editable paths stay saved.

drafts.zu: Amamephu e-AI acwebezelayo awabonisi imigqa eyengeziwe yendlela yezimoto; izindlela zakho ezihlelwayo zihlala zigciniwe.
drafts.st: Dimmapa tse ntle tsa AI ha di bontshe mela e phetilweng ya tsela ya koloi; ditsela tseo o ka di fetolang di dula di bolokilwe.
drafts.ts: Mimepe yo saseka ya AI a yi kombisi swiletelo leswi phindhiweke swa ndlela ya timovha; tindlela ta wena leti hlelekaka ti sala ti hlayisiwile.
drafts.ve: Mapa dza AI dzo nakaho a dzi sumbedzi mitalo yo dovhololwaho ya nḓila ya zwiendedzi; nḓila dzaṋu dzine dza nga dzudzanywa dzi dzula dzo vhulungwa.
